title: Mixed Event — Hear Me! Hopeful Show♪

meta.Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! continue their livestreams, but Minori is plagued with unease as she fails to find acceptance from the group's fans. One day, an opportunity arises for a collaboration with a famous former idol turned streamer...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay! Next is...!
Our new segment called...!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Tell Us! MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka & Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This segment will be all about answering the questions you, the viewers, have about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to hear what sorts of questions everyone has for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then let's get started. Does anyone have a question they'd like to ask?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I took up dancing recently! Please tell me how I can get better at it!>
<Which cosmetics do you recommend?>
<What's caught your interest lately?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Thanks, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's start with the one about dancing then!
Haruka, mind fielding this one?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's a great dancer after all. I'd like to hear what you think as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm not sure anything I say will be all that profound, but they mentioned that they just took it up so...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just try to move with the music. It's important to learn the melody and rhythm first to have your body get used to it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When you start doing actual routines, it'll be good to dance in front of a mirror or take a video of yourself practicing to see how you're doing.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<You're the best, Haruka!>
<Like a real pro!>
<Thank you!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Was there anything else anyone would like to ask?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, me! I have a question!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Her?>
<I wanted to ask too...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Go ahead, Minori. We'll get around to their questions too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you!
This one's for everyone...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There are times when I feel like I can't dance or move my body all that well... What should I do when that happens?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whenever that happens, just keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I knew it...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But don't go banging your head against a wall. You should go over what you're having trouble with and focus on those parts. Before you know it, you'll have it down.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That makes so much sense! That means I should use a mirror or camera to see how I'm doing too, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One step at a time, Minori. You always try to juggle everything at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, uh... Right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, I think the most important part of all this is to make it so everyone watching has fun and smiles.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone watching has fun and smiles...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. So it's okay to be more relaxed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...! Everyone, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Everyone gave such good advice.>
<I'm having trouble memorizing dance routines...>
<Is there an easy way to remember them?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. Memorizing routines...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That reminds me. You're good at copying dance routines, Minori. Do you have any advice for them?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me?! Giving advice?!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She is?>
<Tell us!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Maybe I can actually do something for everyone watching...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay! Sure!
I guess I am good at that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You start by... How do I put it into words?
When it comes to ASRUN...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Let me demonstrate!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: La La La~♪ Wishing you a better tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<A live demo?>
<Cool... I don't get it...>
<Some actual advice would be nice...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You can show us what you've learned at another time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For now, is there anything you'd like to tell our viewers?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um, well... Huh?
How do I usually learn these dances?
B-Brute force! Learn by doing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That doesn't really help...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? No, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Great job, everyone.
That went pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it did. It seemed like everyone watching also had quite a bit of fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori gave us plenty of comic relief as usual too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I wasn't joking or anything...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's one of your best qualities, but let's be careful about how we give advice next time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right, I'm sorry about what I did there...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (My chance to do something helpful...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry. It's important to learn from our mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's right. And seeing you dance like that was pretty good too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then I'm glad I passed things off to her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, the segments and content you've been coming up with have been doing really well too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. The Q&A segment we did with each other a few days ago even turned out great.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. You seem to have an incredibly strong grasp of how our fans feel and what they want.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I do...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. I'll keep trying my best to make sure everyone enjoys seeing what we do!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Will they like today's stream...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I stumbled partway through but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just have to keep trying. Then I'll become as good as Haruka and...!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hey, have you heard about MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Yeah! Haruka Kiritani's new group, right?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Shizuku and Airi are in it too. It's strange seeing them together, but their streams are so good...!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Right?! Today's stream was pretty good too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They're watching our streams...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I don't believe it. They're really talking about us...)

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Oh, but what about that other girl?
The amateur...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Oh, her? What was her name...? Minori?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
She seems so plain.
Like a normal person, you know?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Yeah, the other three alone seems like plenty. Why do they need her around?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: She messed up pretty bad today too. Maybe she's Haruka's friend or something?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Anyway, I can't wait for their next stream.
Wanna watch it together?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good! And I hope Haruka sees my comments next time...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Yeah... I really haven't contributed much since we started doing this...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I haven't been able to give our viewers anything...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I need to keep trying. More and more...!
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice work, Minori!
You're doing great today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's take a quick break.
Here, stay hydrated too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, Airi! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You did really well back there, Minori. You made a difficult routine like that look so easy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! Yay...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Okay, I need to keep this up! I have to keep trying to catch up to everyone else...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um, before we get started again, there's something I'd like to talk about.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's up, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know this may seem sudden, but how would you feel about a joint stream?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A joint stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In a nutshell, we won't be by ourselves. We'll be doing a stream together with another person.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Did you have someone in mind?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's someone I know. She left her group a little while ago and started streaming for a living.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Her name's Nanami Hayakawa from...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, THE Nanamin from CreamBerry...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hayakawa? Oh, we were on the same show a few times.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She was so popular. She was on TV and did all these shows, but suddenly decided to quit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That surprised me too. I didn't know she's streaming now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?! She has 800,000 subscribers...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. She's as popular as ever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But why are you bragging about it...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Truth be told, when we were still looking for an agency to join, I asked her about any possible leads.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then she started showing interest in our group, which led to her asking, If you're freelancing, wanna work together on something?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Th-This is huge...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It is. This is our chance to let everyone know that MORE MORE JUMP! is here to stay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: 800,000 subscribers too...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So what exactly are we doing for this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, I've only heard a little about what we'll be doing but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It sounds like we'll be doing two streams to sort of mark the occasion.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Two?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Calm down, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyways...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The first one will just include a talk segment where Hayakawa introduces us to her fans.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's so nice of her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The second will be a show with all of us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaaaat...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A show?! We're doing an actual show?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka, are you being serious?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Hayakawa's already done quite a few shows online herself and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's even gone ahead and booked where we'll be performing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So everyone will be able to see the four of us performing together...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A show for everyone to see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've done our share of them in SEKAI, but we can finally do one in real life...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We can...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka. Ideally, it would've been us putting on our own show but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We will, Airi. Someday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Right... Everyone else already has experience being on stage and delivering hope to others...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have to find a way and do the same...!)
The next day

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So there you have it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP! will be doing a joint stream with Nanamin!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka & Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay!!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Whoa, that's awesome!!>
<Former idols only...?>
<What are you gonna do?!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll be having a friendly chat with Nanamin for a part of it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But what we're going to talk about is still a secret. We hope that you'll tune in to find out...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we have a special announcement that I'm sure you'll all be thrilled to hear!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<An announcement?!>
<What is it?!>
<Tell us...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-We'll...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<You'll...?!>
<Hurry...!>
<My heart's racing!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll reveal that on the day of the stream...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Aww, c'mon...!>
<I got all worked up for nothing.>
<I'll definitely watch!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Stay tuned, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I can't believe this is happening!>
<I'm definitely watching!!>
<I can't wait...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They all sound so excited...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have to make sure that I don't let them down...!)
The day of the joint stream
Nanamin's studio

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for having us, Hayakawa.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Thank you for coming! I'm glad you could all make it!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: For those I haven't already met, I'm Nanami Hayakawa. Call me Nanamin♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's great to meet you, finally!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, um... It's nice to meet you, Nanamin!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Oh, you must be Minori!
I've been dying to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
M-M-Me?!
Namamin?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Hehe. Haruka told me everything. It sounds like you really mean quite a lot to her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: You're the one that put on a show for her when she was really down and cheered her up, right?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: She even told me how happy she was about you being there for her and how that you're the reason she wanted to become an idol again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka said that...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Stop, you're embarrassing me...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Oh, don't be like that!
Your story was so touching!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: You were always so strict and professional when it came to work. It's astonishing that someone made you feel this way.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
That's why I became so interested.
I couldn't wait to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You're exaggerating...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori has even helped me out a few times already...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. MORE MORE JUMP! never would've gotten off the ground if it weren't for Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why we need you to keep trying your hardest, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, I will! More, more, more...!
So I can catch up to everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Great! Then let's do everything we can to get your guys' name out there!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: I also want everyone to know why you're so valuable, and we can work on that together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Hayakawa!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: You're more than welcome! Now, let's discuss things one last time before we get rolling.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So we'll be sticking to the script for the most part?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Yup! I'll have you introduce yourselves and talk about what led to you forming your group. At the end, we'll reveal that we'll be putting on a show for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Depending on what kind of comments we see and choose to pick up, we'll have to improvise, so I hope you'll be ready for a few of those too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you got it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's do our best, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, relax...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
It's Nanamin!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Hi!!>
<Nanamiiin!!!>
<Finally!! The wait is over!!>

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Great! As peppy as ever, I see☆

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: And today, we'll be having some special guests join us!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: I'm sure some of you already know them, but allow me to introduce...!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Tadaa! MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
I'm Haruka Kiritani from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Airi Momoi here!
Thanks for tuning in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm Shizuku Hinomori.
Glad to see everyone's here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I, um...! I'm Minori Hanasato!
P-Pleased to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Haha. Thanks everyone!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<It's Haruka and Shizuku!>
<Airi's here too!>
<Yeah, they formed their own group.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <How do you guys know Nanamin?>

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Actually, we've known each other since when we were still idols and even went out to dinner a few times together too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We also kept in touch to see how each of us was doing as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I didn't know that.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: That's why when I heard about Haruka forming a new group, I jumped right on it!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: They even started doing their own streams too! I started to sense a sort of strange connection between us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And you came up with the idea of doing something together, right?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Yup! I'm so glad you all came today!!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Wow. I never knew...>
<That's news to me!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Thank you, Nanamin! Please let everyone know about MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It looks like some of our fans are here too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to see us, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Huh? Who's she?>
<Who's that?>
<A new idol, maybe?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
M-My name is Minori Hanasato!
It's a pleasure to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<An amateur girl?>
<She doesn’t have that idol aura.>
<She's nothing like everyone else.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: M-Minori is...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <You can do it, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They're cheering me on...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Right! I have to keep going...!
I have to keep smiling...!)

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Minori's still pretty new to this, so expectations for her are a little all over the place. But I think she'll blossom into something beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: And I have Haruka to back me up on that!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Really?>
<If Nanamin says so...>
<Interesting...>

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: So let's talk a little bit more about Minori and how you all ended up forming MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<An origin story?>
<Tell us!>
<MORE MORE JUMP! is the best!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Even the people that are seeing us for the first time are showing interest...!)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Tell us more about Minori!>
<I can't wait...>
<What's Minori like?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Some are interested in me... I've never gotten this kind of attention before...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I can't let them down.
I have to do my best!)

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Alright! Let's get started♪

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka & Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
Nanamin's studio

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Let's get started with a few questions about how you formed MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Is it true that this all started because you all attend the same school?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Despite knowing that we all attend the same school, we never really spoke to each other until we met up on our school's rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It really wasn't that long ago, but it sort of feels like it. Minori and Haruka met first, with me and Shizuku joining after that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori first asked us about learning how to dance better in order to pass her auditions, and things started to change quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Miku and Rin were also important, but I doubt I can really talk about that here...)

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: I see... So you're saying Minori was the key to forming this group?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: In that case, let me ask you this♪

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Minori, you're the only member of MORE MORE JUMP! without any experience working as an idol, right? Do you ever feel nervous about doing streams with everyone else?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Always!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You don't have to be that honest.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe... I'm still a long way behind in terms of my dancing and singing skills too, but I want to keep trying my best to catch up to everyone else...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yeah, she's always kinda like that lol...>
<Her dance moves do look a little unpolished.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori may still have quite a bit to work on...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But she's also the reason why the rest of us wanted to return to being idols.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why I want her to stand proud and keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<If you say so, Haruka.
Is she really that good?>
<She doesn't look it...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She may look that way to you, but her determination is unbelievable. She's helped us so much already too... Oh, and she kept on trying even after failing 50 auditions...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Wait, 50?!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Seriously?! 50 times?! lol>
<She's cute but sorta plain.>
<That's amazing. She just kept going.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We had our share of worries too, but she was always there for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's an invaluable member of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Hehe. You really must be something to have earned everyone's trust like this!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
